notes: This contract pins the bounded HLAreportFederateLost delivery route to the exact IEEE 1516.1-2025 non-timestamped C++ Receive Interaction callback. For this RTI-originated interaction only, Umbra supplies a default-invalid FederateHandle as a local adapter representation of no joined-federate producer. That is neither a numeric sentinel nor a standards-defined producer-designator mapping; it must not be generalized to generic RTI-created MOM traffic. The private HLAfederate endpoint is used only for routing and is not exposed as sent regions; ordinary and DDM-matching regional subscription are covered under both HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE. A composite asynchronous-delivery case additionally ties the report's encoded cutoff to one separately received timestamped interaction; it is not a generic MOM timing claim. The route is source/API traceability only; the broader page-50 TSO cutoff/delivery matrix, remote transport, JUnit/protected review, and conformance remain open. RL-065 records the underlying Lab crosswalk gap.
